description: This PHP source file defines a data model class 'CandidateHistoryDetailedModel' used for API serialization within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It models detailed information about candidate history records including relationships to candidate, vacancy, hiring manager, and interview entities, and uses OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: CandidateHistoryDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes detailed candidate history data for API responses, implementing normalization and including detailed property annotations.
